thread:
Maria: Quick notes from the alignment sweep on rtx-8000 cluster. Summary: tuning KV stripe alignment and selector hysteresis to fix MQA regressions when using paged-KV. Observed a reproducible throughput dip for mixed short/long workloads when KV page blocksize >= 64 and alignment left at default.

Raj: Can you drop the raw benchmark and the exact bench flags you used?

Maria: Paste of one representative run (mixed dist: 4/16/64/256):
```
# run: align-sweep-rtx8
model: redwood-3b-quant
hw: rtx-8000 x8
batcher: continuous, max_tokens=8192
kv_blocksize: 64
kv_align: 64 (default)
selector: autotune-hysteresis-v1 (seq_gate=224)
throughput:
  seq=4    -> 2.05M tok/s
  seq=16   -> 1.25M tok/s
  seq=64   -> 480k tok/s
  seq=256  -> 60k tok/s
delta vs baseline: -3.9% overall
latency: p95 bumped ~7ms on seq=16/64
kv_page_miss: cold spike +20%
```

perf-bot: regression alert: -3.9% throughput for config kv_blocksize=64/kv_align=64. see https://perf.redwood.local/runs/2290001111

Kevin: hypothesis: with align=64 we land KV stripes on suboptimal boundaries causing the paged-attn kernel to take a copy+pad slow path for micro-batches (MQA). If we align to 256 bytes we can avoid the memcpy threshold on our GPUs. Also the selector is oscillating because kv-frag metric jumps during warmup.

Sam: I ran align=256 on A100 machines and swapped the selector to add 0.15 copy_penalty when kv_frag>0.35. Results: recovered ~2.8% of throughput, cold misses down 12%, p95 back close to baseline for short sequences.

Olga: good. We should also add a small hysteresis window so the selector doesn't flip decisions within a 10s warmup period per page. That avoids flip-flopping between copy and nocopy kernels when traffic is bursty.

Maria: agreed. Plan: 1) Sam: run grid sweep of kv_align=[64,128,256], kv_blocksize=[32,64,128], kv_frag_threshold=[0.25,0.35,0.45], copy_penalty=[0.1,0.15] for 2k steps each and upload to perf dashboard. 2) Kevin: land selector change with hysteresis state and --expose-selector-debug flag. 3) Olga: add per-route histogram of cold_page_miss by seq-bucket to Console. 4) Raj: audit batcher packing to ensure we don't cram many tiny sequences into a GQA path after changing seq_gate.

Raj: note: lowering seq_gate from 256 to 224 reduced overpacking in one test but increased small-batch overheads. We'll run a small ablation to pick the sweet spot.

Maria: temporary mitigation for prod: set kv_align=256 for customers on RTX-class hardware and enable selector copy_penalty when kv_frag>0.35.

perf-bot: queued job 2290001122: align-grid-sweep by Sam. Expected finish in 18h.

Kevin: also experimenting with a lightweight in-kernel fast-path check to avoid memcpy when the stripe is aligned but page contents are contiguous. Might get another 0.5-1% back without global policy changes.

Sam: starting the sweep now, will post dashboard link and CSV artifacts when done.

Maria: thanks. Keeping thread open for results. Last message ts=2285003600
